# DPA · SDT — Self Declared Token | Decentralized Partnership Agreement
> Document partnership agreements between crypto wallet holders, link wallets to self-declared passport details, and record participation shares

## About
Compiled public interface for Self-Declared Tokens and Decentralized Partnership Agreements. Explore fictional declarations, off-chain terms, acceptance records and participation. A separate wallet-free verifier compares all 13 exact original fields with historical acceptance snapshots. This repository is a manual static snapshot, not application source. It does not rebuild from edits.

- Author: Maxim Osovsky — https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
- Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT
- Website: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
- Example: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/dpa.html?example=1
- License: existing CC BY 4.0 site-content attribution; bundled dependencies retain their own licenses. No blanket repository-wide relicensing.
- Safety: creation workflows use fictional fixtures and test ETH only. The verifier processes voluntarily disclosed original identifiers locally; reports omit them by default. No verified identity or legal certification.
- Verifier: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/verify.html
